new_defects.note: The attempt-reason enum defines DuressWipe and pins its value in a test, but no code records it (a search of secure/src, nonsecure/src and tools finds only the definition and the test). The wipe-on-duress arm returns PinLocked and is therefore logged as AlreadyAtMax at secure/src/nsc/mod.rs:1649. Recording it would also be a deniability tell while the log is readable on a locked device (#719), so this is a decide-and-document item, low severity.
